actions.action: Move plant 1-2 m back from the window, out of direct sun
Alternatively add a sheer curtain to the window
Switch to rainwater, filtered water, or tap water left to sit out
Flush the pot thoroughly every month or two
Water at soil level and empty the saucer after 15-20 minutes
Check that the top 3-4 cm of soil is dry before watering
Slide the plant out of the pot to check the roots
Ensure the pot has drainage and repot in airy mix with perlite if needed
Check the crown for pests like mealybugs or thrips
Trim brown leaf tips with clean scissors

reason: The blackening came from too little light, but the answer blames too much sun and water quality and says to move the plant further from the light, which is the opposite of the fix (moving it outside) and would likely make it worse.
